content: This is beautiful. Are we setting up camp here or are we going to follow the trail down to the river?
Let's rest here for a bit. I told the others to meet us here, so we could take advantage of the view. But we should go down to the river to put up the tents.
How did you find out about this place? It seems pretty far away from towns.
My dad used to live near here. When I was young, my uncle took my brother and me to his cabin and we used to fish there.
Why don't we just sleep there then?
It's abandoned, so there's nothing there. By the way, did you bring the water up from the car?
No, I thought you brought it. Now, we have to go back down to the car.
Calm down. The river flowing all around us is a clean water source.
What was that noise? Oh, Scott!
It's probably the other guys on the trail, unless it's a monster.
